scope: Read-only precision/applicability screen; no serving code changed and no package executed. Exact tracked source in pinned SGLang checkout.
findings: Muse adapter routes NVFP4 weights through mma_type=nvfp4xnvfp4 with group16 quantizing pre-dispatch, so original BF16 activation contract is not preserved.
Its alternate BF16 branch expects BF16 checkpoint weights, not a direct original-NVFP4-weight contract.
The separate SM90 MegaMoE path explicitly uses quantizing FP8 pre-dispatch and fp8_mega_moe; it cannot be adopted as a BF16-activation shortcut.
No performance result against our current H200 NVFP4/BF16 parent established.
